english.note: Use this when preserving an item, arrangement, policy, or right instead of removing or abolishing it.
Use this for retaining or withholding something, including in expressions such as reserving the right to do something.

examples.english: We will retain the current arrangement.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bou2 lau4 jin6 haang4 on1 paai4

examples.english: We reserve the right to pursue responsibility.
examples.traditional: 我哋保留追究責任嘅權利。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bou2 lau4 zeoi1 gau3 zaak3 jam6 ge3 kyun4 lei6
